summary: Stinnett states he would vote no on continued U.S. funding to Israel until Netanyahu is replaced and Israel makes restitution.
quote: If elected I would be a no vote on continued funding to Israel until we see these changes made (by Netanyahu's successor).

summary: Stinnett states Netanyahu and hardliners are 'guilty in plain sight of genocide of the Palestinian people.'
quote: Netanyahu and the hardliners that maintain his fragile hold on power (and his personal freedom) are guilty in plain sight of genocide of the Palestinian people.
